thought: the council votes when it votes
line: The council will vote when it votes. I am only chieftain.

thought: if the vote goes well or not, the hall drinks
line: If the vote goes well, the hall will drink. If not, the hall drinks.

thought: let the council decide by old law
line: Let the council decide. That is the old law, and I keep it.

thought: the trials make or break a warrior
line: The trials make a warrior or break one. Nothing in between.

thought: hopes this one works out
line: Seven votes. Let us see if this one gets there.

thought: elders all talk about the newcomer
line: The elders argue about the newcomer day and night. Good for them.

thought: he won't sway the vote
line: A chieftain does not tip the council's scales. Not even a little.

thought: keg ready either way
line: I shall have a keg ready either way. A wise chieftain plans.

thought: the elders are talking, a start
line: The elders are talking about you, outerlander. That is a start.

thought: they fight for their place
line: You fight for your place. That is the Fremennik way.

thought: more Fremennik in them than some born here
line: There is more Fremennik in you than in some born here.

thought: would like a drink with them as one of us
line: Keep on, outerlander. I would like to drink with you as one of us.

thought: win them and have a seat in the hall
line: Win the council over and there is a seat in this hall for you.

thought: not given up, ahead of most
line: Ha! You have not given up. That alone puts you ahead of most.

thought: tells the hall about the stubborn outerlander
line: Mark that one. Stubborn as a Fremennik already.

thought: outerlander is no insult while they try
line: Still outerlander, aye, but I say it fondly now.

thought: still an outerlander; elders in no hurry
line: Still an outerlander, I see. The elders are in no hurry.

thought: council will see through them, or not
line: The council will see through you, outerlander. Or not. Ha!

thought: tired already
line: Tired already, outerlander? Our children run further than that.

thought: don't come crying about the elders
line: Do not come crying to me about the elders. I only rule here.

thought: don't try winning them with magic
line: If you mean to win them with magic, do not bother.

thought: running about begging votes
line: Running about Rellekka begging for votes, outerlander? Ha!

thought: could they win a drinking contest
line: Seven votes? You could not win a drinking contest, outerlander.

thought: half a Fremennik
line: Half a Fremennik, you are. The worse half, so far.
